verdict.rationale: Granola documents a Zapier integration reaching 8,000+ apps, and Granola Chat can draft and send Slack messages, with a review step before anything is sent. Notion is mentioned only as a use case for building on the Granola API, which is a developer building block, not a native Notion integration. Slack delivery is also chat-triggered per message rather than automatic channel syncing. Missing for 10: a native Notion page sync, automatic posting of notes to Slack channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Zapier and Slack flows.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier

citations.quote: Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting
